name: GnomeEQ
description: An 11-band graphic equalizer for your whole system, one click away in the top bar. Equalizes every app — browser, games, VLC, music — by routing the default output through a native PipeWire filter chain. Bands sit on the ISO octave centres from 20 Hz to 20 kHz and are colour-coded by frequency range. Ships tuned presets, saves your own, and remembers the one you picked.
